name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-04-13, at wavelengths from 1.40 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
